meta.source: Derived from a reference screenshot of a dark pro-audio EQ; values sampled and normalised, not copied from any vendor's assets.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest well: meter troughs, the area under the 0 dB line when the analyzer is off, inset fields.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Graph and window background. The default ground for every text and curve token.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Floating band panel, top bar and status bar. Sits on surface-100 with shadow-panel.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised controls on surface-200: knob faces, shape and stereo selectors, readout chips.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Hover state of a surface-300 control.

tokens.name: line-grid
tokens.usage: Frequency and gain grid lines in the graph. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel edges, dividers between bar groups, knob track (unfilled part).

tokens.name: line-zero
tokens.usage: The 0 dB reference line across the graph.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100…300: preset name, menu items, knob labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: parameter captions, '(multiple)', inactive bar items. ≥6:1 on surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-axis
tokens.usage: Graph axis labels (Hz, analyzer dB). 5.2:1 on surface-100; never use on surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled or bypassed text. Fails 4.5:1 on purpose — never for information a user must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Am-Q amber. The summed response curve, knob value arcs, EQ gain scale numerals, active readouts. 10:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/drag state of an accent element.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (rare: selected toggle chips).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: band-1
tokens.usage: Band 1 handle, fill and stroke. Default for the first band created (usually a low cut).

tokens.name: band-2
tokens.usage: Band 2. Also the hue a band takes while its gain clips (see signal-clip).

tokens.name: band-3
tokens.usage: Band 3.

tokens.name: band-4
tokens.usage: Band 4.

tokens.name: band-5
tokens.usage: Band 5. Lowest-lightness band hue: 3.9:1 on surface-100, the floor for new band colours.

tokens.name: band-6
tokens.usage: Band 6.

tokens.name: band-7
tokens.usage: Band 7.

tokens.name: band-8
tokens.usage: Band 8. Bands 9–24 cycle 1–8; the panel's # readout disambiguates.

tokens.name: analyzer-pre
tokens.usage: Pre-EQ spectrum fill (solid, behind everything).

tokens.name: analyzer-post
tokens.usage: Post-EQ spectrum line, 1px.

tokens.name: analyzer-sc
tokens.usage: Side-chain spectrum line, 1px dashed 2/2.

tokens.name: meter-ok
tokens.usage: Level meter below −18 dBFS.

tokens.name: meter-hot
tokens.usage: Level meter −18 to −3 dBFS, and the peak-hold tick.

tokens.name: signal-clip
tokens.usage: Meter above −3 dBFS, clip LEDs, the gain knob's over-range wedge.

tokens.name: signal-solo
tokens.usage: Solo/listen indicator dot. Same value as band-6 by design; always paired with a text label.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product wordmark only, in accent.

styles.name: preset
styles.usage: Preset name in the top bar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Top/status bar items, menu items, selector text.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live parameter values. Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: scale
styles.usage: EQ gain scale (accent) and frequency axis (ink-axis).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Meter scale, band index badges. Minimum size; never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, meter channel gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding (horizontal), bar item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Band panel inner padding, gap between knobs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top/status bar side padding, group gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Distance of the band panel from the graph's bottom edge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Menu items and segmented-control segments.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Readout chips, tooltips, meter caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Selectors (shape, stereo), toolbar buttons, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The floating band panel and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Band handles, knobs, status dots.

tokens.name: size-handle
tokens.usage: Band handle diameter (22px while selected).

tokens.name: size-knob-xs
tokens.usage: Dynamics knobs (Range, Threshold, Attack, Release, Density).

tokens.name: size-knob-sm
tokens.usage: Freq and Q knobs.

tokens.name: size-knob-lg
tokens.usage: Gain knob, the panel's centre.

tokens.name: size-meter
tokens.usage: Width of one meter channel.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Height of top bar and status bar.

tokens.name: opacity-band-fill
tokens.usage: Fill between a band's curve and 0 dB (selected band: 0.55).

tokens.name: opacity-band-idle
tokens.usage: Fill of non-selected bands while another band is being dragged.

tokens.name: opacity-bypassed
tokens.usage: Whole-band opacity when the band is bypassed.

tokens.name: opacity-preview
tokens.usage: EQ Match fitted nodes beyond the Bands slider (not applied).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The floating band panel and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-handle
tokens.usage: Band handles: a ground-coloured ring keeps them legible over curves.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Knob face bevel.
